Bridge a WeChat bot (or other IM) into the agent via a remote gateway adapter.

Setup steps:
1. Deploy an OneBot v11/v12 or wechaty gateway service next to your WeChat bot (e.g. NapCat, go-cqhttp, NoneBot, or wechaty-puppet-wechat).
2. Expose its REST/SSE API on a reachable host:port.
3. Fill Base URL with the gateway REST API address (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000).
4. Fill Auth token if the gateway requires one.

The app polls the gateway over REST/SSE — no persistent IM connection is held on-device, so battery and background use stay low.

Empty = allow all senders (use with caution)

Format: smsf#function#action#param

Supported:
 smsf#shell#exec#<cmd> Run ADB Shell command (root/Shizuku)
 smsf#ai#chat#<prompt> Ask AI to generate a reply
 smsf#wifi#on Turn WiFi on
 smsf#wifi#off Turn WiFi off
 smsf#help Show this help

Notes:
 - Commands run locally on-device, no network needed
 - shell/wifi require root or Shizuku authorized
 - Results are shown via local notification
